items.title: Stagwell Soars 13% on Raised Outlook, Eyes “Number One in Marketing Transformation”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStagwell (STGW:NASDAQ) shares jumped 13% on Thursday after record third-quarter results and a higher full-year profit outlook, then gave back about 3% after hours. Digital Transformation grew 23% organically and The Marketing Cloud grew 108%, while Marketing Services shrank.

items.title: What Does WPP (LSE:WPP) Keeping A Global Media Brief Really Change?
items.summary: WPP (LSE:WPP) retained its global media remit for The Coca-Cola Company after a major review of advertising partners. Omnicom secured Coca-Cola's media account for North America after Publicis stepped away from the regional business, while WPP retained its global media role outside North America, Japan and South Korea.

items.title: Omnicom (OMC) Q3 Earnings Reveal Margin Strength And Debt Pressure
items.summary: Omnicom Group stock barely budged after Q3 2026 earnings, ticking up about 0.2% to roughly US$83. On the surface that looks like a shrug from the market. The headline is anything but sleepy. The company delivered adjusted earnings per share of US$2.73 and an adjusted EBITA margin of 18.2% for the quarter, both backed by 7.2% organic growth in its core advertising and media operations. items.title: OMC Q3 deep dive: Integration synergies and media growth drive margin expansion
items.summary: Global advertising giant Omnicom Group (NYSE:OMC) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 59.1% year on year to $6.42 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.73 per share was 2.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
